inference.warmup: one explicit zero-image prediction excluded from all timings

quality_procedure.endpoint_success: Corresponding returned endpoint has Euclidean original-pixel error <= radius; denominator includes all gold-visible endpoints and misses.
quality_procedure.both_point_success: Both corresponding endpoints returned and each error <= radius; denominator is all objects with both gold points visible, including misses.
quality_procedure.availability: returned_on_unlocatable_reference counts eligible coordinates for gold v0 endpoints only on matched objects; denominator is unlocatable_on_matched_objects. No hidden coordinate error is computed.
quality_procedure.returned: Endpoint confidence >= 0.5, finite coordinates, 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height on a matched object.
quality_procedure.zero_denominator: null; empty scenes still contribute detection false positives

per_seed.verification_scope: Saved-prediction replay, complete-run and paired-checkpoint evidence consistency; no model weights loaded or verified here.

comparison_rule.dominance: All five unrounded metrics no higher, at least one strictly lower; unavailable statistics cannot pass.

aggregation.definition: Equal-weight arithmetic mean/min/max of the two seed-level candidate-minus-reference metric deltas; no rounding before aggregation.
aggregation.conditional_quantiles: Each median/p95 is computed within one model and seed on its returned visible endpoints. The mean of seed-level quantile deltas is not a pooled endpoint quantile.

historical_context.reason: Historical source is different and the earlier runtime/session is not bound as part of this prospective study. Seed 42 is context, not a third matched run.

decision_scope: This repeatability study authorizes no promotion and does not change the original seed-42 decision or acceptance rule.
verification_scope: Saved-prediction replay and checkpoint-evidence consistency for both fixed seeds; current training/evaluation source hashes, matched source/runtime/settings, and common M0 payloads checked. No model weights loaded or verified here.
limits: Only two prospective paired seeds; both outcomes are retained, including regressions or ties.
Repeated development validation is not an independent test. Related images/endpoints are not independent trials.
Conditional endpoint errors must be read with missed objects and missing endpoints; per-seed denominators and common-endpoint diagnostics remain in per_seed.
A repeated trend under these recorded runtimes does not establish unseen-scene generalization, a physical error tolerance, statistical significance, or bitwise GPU determinism.
Missing/failed seeds or undefined primary statistics refuse a complete summary; partial results cannot become a winner.
